name: release-9-1-handshake-suggestion
description: The ggui_handshake suggestion in the shape ggui tag 9.1 (60a234ce0, serving prod) emits on a cache hit: `origin: cache`, the templated `match-semantic` rationale, a full `blueprintMeta` WITHOUT `matchedIntent`, and the contract summary. Built with that release's own `blueprintKey` / `summarizeContract` / `decide-handshake` cache-hit shape (the suggestion schema, key and summary code are unchanged since 60a234ce0). Today's handshakeSuggestionSchema MUST accept it: `blueprintMeta.matchedIntent` (#1336) is optional, so a consumer holding this release's payload keeps parsing (VERSION-POLICY §3.6).
